_comment: Status of every capability the repository advertises. A module listed here as not_implemented does not exist in src/ and must never be read as a feature. tests/test_module_truth.py enforces that src/ contains no unimported module outside this list.

not_implemented.linkage: identity linkage: blocking, comparison, clustering, matching
not_implemented.privacy.risk_assessment: k-anonymity / re-identification measurement at run time
not_implemented.evaluation.metrics: independent verification and scoring of released files
not_implemented.security.encryption: AES-GCM envelope encryption (not needed: no identity mapping is stored)
not_implemented.detection.gazetteers: lexicons are harvested at run time from the input tree
